title: Brand Narrative Directive is an evidence-bound NO_DISPATCH handoff
summary: Brand Narrative Directive v0.1-dev4 bridges governed Brand evidence toward an external narrative authority. It retains Communications Discovery and Librarian revision/source-lineage evidence without converting that evidence into truth, bias, claim, dispatch or publication authority.
invariants: The handoff is NO_DISPATCH and publication authority NONE.
Communications HOLD_* remains an external evidence hold gate; storing a detached review snapshot does not confer freshness or approval.
Librarian RETRACTED is retraction evidence, not falsity.
Conflicted terminal revisions remain conflict evidence; the directive does not select a winner.
Shared declared roots are SHARED_DECLARED_ORIGIN, not verified provenance or editorial independence.
Different declared roots do not establish independence.
Dynamic Story, Communications Management, Institutional Policy, publication, channel execution and Intention Service remain independently owned.
procedure: Project governed Brand evidence into a narrative handoff candidate.
Attach detached Communications/Librarian evidence without promoting its authority.
Leave approval, activation, publication and dispatch to separately owned external authorities.

provenance.claim: dev4 handoff remains NO_DISPATCH/publication authority NONE and treats correction/retraction/conflict/source-lineage as evidence only.
